title: Update the details of a beekeeper registration
summary: If you are already registered as a beekeeper in NSW, you can update your details online.
intro: If you're registered as a beekeeper in NSW, you can update your details online.
who_can_apply: You must be registered as a beekeeper in NSW.
what_you_need: Your Department of Primary Industries username and password
Your registration number and the expiry date

how_to_steps.text: Login to the Department of Primary Industries portal.
Follow the prompts to update your details.

more_info.text: You should update your details as soon as possible to ensure any correspondence such as a renewal notice is sent to the correct name and mailing address, and has the correct licence fee.

NSW beekeepers will need to adhere to the Australian Honey Bee Industry Biosecurity Code of Practice as a condition of registration. For more information, visit the Department of Primary Industries website.
